description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapFiltersBar' which provides a user interface for filtering a mindmap based on salary range, skill similarity, and time horizon. It includes UI elements such as sliders, buttons, and select dropdowns, and manages user interactions to update filter state.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Updates the salary range filters and triggers the onChange callback.

methods.name: setSimilarity
methods.description: Updates the skill similarity filter ensuring the value stays within 0 to 1.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all filters to default values.
